result:

Muninn has no decision record on the async runtime. `muninn why` reported the evidence as insufficient. It only turned up two conflicting session notes, each at trust 1, meaning they were seen in transcripts but not confirmed. One says async-std and the other says tokio. Neither is a recorded decision, and neither shows which came first, so I used neither.

If you tell me which runtime you want, that decision can be recorded and the doc updated.
